97-01.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.

98-01.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.

100-01.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

101-01.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

101-02.translation: (May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.)(taqwa: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.)
101-02.recitationOnly: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

102-01.translation: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu 'Akber (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah (Glory is to Allah)
102-01.guidance:
Jabir said:
Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu'Akber Allah is the Most Great and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah Glory is to Allah

103-01.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.

104-01.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.

105-01.translation: Ibn 'umar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.)
105-01.recitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.
105-01.guidance: Ibn ʿUmar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. and then he would say:

106-01.translation: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
106-01.recitationOnly:
All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.
All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
106-01.guidance:
When something pleased the Prophet, he would say:
When something displeased him, he would say:
parts: All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.
All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.

107-01.translation: The Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.
107-01.guidance:
The Prophet PBUH said:
‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

107-02.translation: He (PBUH) also said: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.
107-02.guidance:
He PBUH also said:
‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.

107-03.translation: He (PBUH) also said: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.
107-03.guidance:
He PBUH also said:
‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.

107-04.translation: The Prophet [PBUH] said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my 'Ummah (nation).
107-04.guidance:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:
'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings or prayers of peace of my'Ummah nation.

107-05.translation: The Prophet [PBUH] said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings
107-05.guidance:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:
'No one sends greetings or prayers of peace upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

108-01.translation: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.
108-01.guidance:
The Messenger of Allah said:
‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.

108-02.translation: Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.
108-02.guidance: Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend charitably out of the little you have.

108-03.translation: Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet : ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied: Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.
108-03.guidance:
Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet: ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied:
Feed the poor, and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.

109-01.translation: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: (And upon you.)
109-01.guidance: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying:

110-01.translation: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.
110-01.guidance: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.

111-01.translation: If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.
111-01.guidance: If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.

112-01.translation: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.

113-01.translation: He said: ‘If anyone of you is impelled to praise his brother, then he should say: ‘I deem so-and-so to be…and Allah is his reckoner…and I don’t praise anyone, putting it (i.e. my praising) forward, in front of Allah’s commendation, however I assume him so and so’…if he knows that of him.
113-01.recitationOnly: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.
113-01.guidance:
He said: If anyone of you is compelled to praise his companion, then he should say:
If he knows those qualities of him, he may add: I consider him to be such-and-such.

114-01.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].

115-01.translation: Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
115-01.recitationOnly: Here I am O Allah, in response to Your call, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

116-01.translation: The Prophet circled the Ka'bah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: (Allah is the greatest)
116-01.guidance: The Prophet circled the Kaʿbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: Allah is the greatest

117-01.translation: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: (O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.)
117-01.recitationOnly: Our Lord, give us what is good in this world and what is good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
117-01.guidance: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone:

118-01.translation: (Jabir said when describing the Prophet’s pilgrimage: ‘…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: (Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah…) (I begin with what Allah began with.) so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the Ka'bah, he then faced it and said: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things amnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.)) (he would repeat this action at Marwah.)
118-01.recitationOnly:
Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.
118-01.guidance:
When the Prophet approached Ṣafā, he recited:
He climbed Ṣafā until he could see the Kaʿbah, faced the qiblah, and proclaimed Allah’s oneness and greatness:
He then said:
Then make a personal supplication between each recitation.
He made a personal supplication between repetitions and repeated the remembrance three times. At Marwah, he repeated the same sequence of remembrance and personal supplication.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.

119-01.translation: The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of 'arafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.)
119-01.recitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.
119-01.guidance: The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of ʿArafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said is:

120-01.translation: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash aril Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great), Allaahu Ahad (Allah is One) and Laa ilaaha illallaah (There is none worthy of worship but Allah). He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.
120-01.guidance: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area Al-Mash aril Haraam. Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar Allah is the Most Great, Allaahu Ahad Allah is One and Laa ilaaha illallaah There is none worthy of worship but Allah. He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.

121-01.translation: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu 'Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
121-01.guidance: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu'Akbar Allah is the Most Great with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after stoning the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it for supplications.

123-01.translation: The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure.
123-01.guidance: The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure.

124-01.translation: Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (In the name of Allah(three times)) the supplicate seven times: (I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.)
124-01.recitationOnly:
In the name of Allah.
I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.
124-01.guidance: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say:
parts: In the name of Allah.
I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.

125-01.translation: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.
125-01.guidance: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.

126-01.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

127-01.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.
127-01.recitationOnly: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, it is from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.

128-01.translation: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. (I take refuge) from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. (I take refuge) from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
128-01.recitationOnly: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.

129-01.translation: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.
129-01.guidance:
The Messenger of Allah said:
‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.

129-02.translation: He also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.
129-02.guidance:
He also said:
‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.

129-03.translation: He also said: ‘Whoever says:(I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.
129-03.recitationOnly: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.
129-03.guidance:
He also said: ‘Whoever says:
Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.

129-04.translation: He said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.
129-04.guidance:
He said:
‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.

129-05.translation: He also said: ‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.
129-05.guidance:
He also said:
‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.

129-06.translation: (He also said: ‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.)(preoccupied: i.e. in a state of ‘forgetfulness’. The Prophet always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord, in attaining a nearness to Allah and having consciousness of Allah to the extent that if this intensity lessened in anyway, he would regard it as a sin and would then race to seek forgiveness from Allah.)
129-06.guidance:
He also said:
‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.

130-01.translation: Whoever says:(How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
130-01.recitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
130-01.guidance:
Whoever says:
a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.

130-02.translation: Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.
130-02.recitationOnly: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
130-02.guidance:
Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says:
Ten times; this is like freeing four persons from the descendants of Ishmael.

130-03.translation: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.)
130-03.recitationOnly: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.
130-03.guidance: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’ There are Two words, which are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious:

130-04.translation: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying: (How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.
130-04.recitationOnly: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.
130-04.guidance:
Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying:
is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.

130-05.translation: Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (How perfect Allah is.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.
130-05.guidance:
Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, and he said:
‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him: How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: How perfect Allah is. one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.

130-06.translation: Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: (How perfect Allah is . The Supreme, and I praise Him.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.
130-06.recitationOnly: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.
130-06.guidance:
Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says:
a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.

130-07.translation: 'abdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘'abdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say: (There is no might nor power except with Allah.)
130-07.recitationOnly: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
130-07.guidance: ʿAbdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘ʿAbdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say:

130-08.translation: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)
130-08.recitationOnly: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.
130-08.guidance:
the most beloved words to Allah are four:
it does not matter which of them you start with.

130-09.translation: Sa'd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He replied: ‘Say:(O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.)
130-09.recitationOnly:
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.
130-09.guidance:
A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah and said, ‘Teach me words to say.’ He replied:
The man then said, ‘These are for my Lord, but what is for me?’ He replied:
parts: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.

130-10.translation: Tariq Al-Ashja'ee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.)
130-10.recitationOnly: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.
130-10.guidance: Tariq Al-Ashjaʿee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words:

130-11.translation: Jabir Ibn ‘'abdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (All praise is for Allah.) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.)
130-11.recitationOnly:
All praise is for Allah.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
130-11.guidance:
The best supplication is:
And the best remembrance is:
parts: All praise is for Allah.
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

130-12.translation: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
130-12.recitationOnly: 'Glorified is Allah', and'The praise is for Allah', and'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and'Allah is the Most Great', and'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
130-12.guidance: The good deeds which endure are

131-01.translation: (Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) ('abdullah Ibn 'amr said: ’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh with his right hand.)
131-01.guidance:
ʿAbdullah Ibn ʿAmr said:
’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh
with his right hand.

132-01.translation: When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour (i.e. the first hour) of the night, (you may) let them (the children) go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps. Peace and blessing be upon our Prophet, Muhammad, and upon his family and his Companions, all of them.
132-01.guidance:
The Prophet PBUH said:
When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour i.e. the first hour of the night, you may let them the children go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps.
